% Background of the cover page, other background on the last page, own text on the cover page
\renewcommand{\gfmcoverbackground}{\AddToShipoutPictureBG*{
    \AtPageUpperLeft{\raisebox{-\height}{\includegraphics[width=\paperwidth]{cover.png}}}
  }}
\renewcommand{\gfmlastbackground}{\AddToShipoutPictureBG*{
    \AtPageLowerLeft{\includegraphics[width=\paperwidth]{last.png}}
  }}
\makeatletter
\renewcommand{\maketitle}{\begin{titlepage}
    \noindent Theme cover\par
    \noindent\@title\par
    \noindent\@author\par
    \noindent\@date
  \end{titlepage}}
\makeatother
